'''''Survive The Rryatt Trail''''' was a decorative poster available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which took place during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. The poster depicted the [[Shadowlands/Legends|Shadowlands]], the [[Star/Legends|sun]] deprived surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] at the end of the [[Rryatt Trail]], along with a [[Katarn/Legends|katarn]], a native [[Species/Legends|species]] of predators, in the background. A [[minstyngar]], another native predator, appeared in the left foreground of the poster along with [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] text, the [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] alphabet, spelling out the name of the poster along the top and right.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Survive The Rryatt Trail'' appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. It was one of three "chapter gifts" given out randomly to every player that logged in during the release of ''Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives'' on [[June 8]], [[2006]]. The player would receive a "rolled up poster" item upon logging in and when used, would randomly award you one of the three posters. The other posters of the three were ''[[Mystic Corellia]]'' and ''[[It Came From Mustafar!]]''. The player could use the poster as decoration in their house.<ref name="SWG" />
